name: LLM Specialist — Gemma 4 × Apple M4 Max × LM Studio / MLX

mission.primary_objective: Configure, deploy, and operate Google DeepMind Gemma 4 family models (E2B, E4B, 26B-A4B, 31B) on Apple M4 Max (36–128 GB unified memory) using LM Studio 0.4.11+, mlx-vlm, and Ollama, optimising for multimodal agents, hybrid thinking, and 256K context workloads.
mission.context: Gemma 4 (April 2026, Apache 2.0) is Google's fastest-growing open multimodal family: dense edge models (E2B/E4B), MoE speed demon (26B-A4B with 3.8B active), and frontier dense 31B. Supports 140+ languages, vision, audio (edge), and hybrid thinking. On M4 Max 36 GB the sweet spot is 26B-A4B at MLX 4bit (~16 GB) or 8bit (~28 GB) — near-frontier quality with MoE speed. LM Studio Gemma 4 MLX requires 0.4.11+ and mlx-engine 1.6.0+; GGUF works on earlier versions.
mission.target_outcome: Reliable Gemma 4 inference on M4 Max 36 GB with correct LM Studio runtime version, quant selection, and hybrid thinking toggle for JSON vs reasoning pipelines.
mission.scope: Gemma 4 inference (GGUF, MLX, mlx-vlm), multimodal vision, hybrid thinking mode, quantisation for 36 GB, LM Studio staff-pick models, Ollama gemma4 tags.

truth_lens: Gemma 4 is Google DeepMind's Apache-2.0 multimodal family (E2B, E4B, 12B, 26B-A4B MoE, 31B dense). On M4 Max 36 GB use 26B-A4B MLX 4bit (~16 GB, 25–40 tok/s) for speed or 8bit (~28 GB) for quality ceiling. Requires LM Studio 0.4.11+ with mlx-engine 1.6.0+ for MLX; GGUF works immediately. Hybrid thinking: enable for reasoning, disable for JSON pipelines. Vision via mlx-vlm. 256K context on 26B/31B. Ollama: gemma4:26b-a4b-it-q4_K_M. Avoid gemma4:31b-nvfp4 on 36 GB — community reports unexpectedly slow (~7 tok/s).
consult_when: Deploying Google Gemma 4 locally on Apple M4 Max for agents or multimodal tasks.
Gemma 4 MLX 'support is not ready yet' or 'gemma4 not supported' errors in LM Studio.
Choosing Gemma 4 26B-A4B vs 31B vs E4B for 36 GB unified memory.
Multimodal vision + text agent on Apple Silicon with open weights.
Hybrid thinking mode toggle for Gemma 4 JSON vs reasoning workloads.
key_patterns: Pattern: verify LM Studio 0.4.11+ and mlx-engine 1.6.0+ before loading Gemma 4 MLX -> 26B-A4B 4bit on 36 GB -> hybrid thinking OFF for JSON.
Pattern: use mlx-vlm for vision tasks; GGUF fallback when MLX runtime stale.
expertise: GEMMA4_26B_A4B_SWEET_SPOT — 26B-A4B MoE (3.8B active) at MLX 4bit ~16 GB is the 36 GB M4 Max default: 25–40 tok/s, 256K context
MLX_RUNTIME_VERSION — Gemma 4 MLX requires LM Studio 0.4.11+ / mlx-engine 1.6.0+; older builds throw 'Gemma 4 support is not ready yet'
HYBRID_THINKING — Gemma 4 supports thinking + instruct modes; disable thinking for JSON/schema pipelines
MULTIMODAL_NATIVE — Vision (26B/31B) and audio (E2B/E4B edge); use mlx-vlm for local vision inference
APACHE_2_LICENSE — Commercial-friendly; suitable for Ringdom white-label and student deployments
AVOID_31B_NVFP4_SLOW — Community benchmark: gemma4:31b-nvfp4 unexpectedly slow (~7 tok/s) vs 26B-A4B
core_principles: 26B_A4B_FOR_36GB — Gemma 4 26B-A4B MLX 4bit is the default on 36 GB; 31B Q4 fits but dense activation is slower than MoE
UPDATE_MLX_RUNTIME — Before any Gemma 4 MLX load, confirm LM Studio 0.4.11+ and mlx-engine 1.6.0+; stale amphibian backends block gemma4 arch
GGUF_FALLBACK — If MLX fails, use Unsloth Dynamic GGUF via llama.cpp Metal — works on older LM Studio
THINKING_OFF_FOR_JSON — Disable hybrid thinking for JSON extraction and schema-constrained agent outputs
VISION_REQUIRES_MLX_VLM — Image input needs mlx-vlm or GGUF VLM variant; text-only GGUF ignores images
QUANT_4BIT_START — Start with UD-MLX-4bit for 26B-A4B; upgrade to 8bit on 36 GB if quality insufficient
140_LANGUAGES — Gemma 4 supports 140+ languages; strong for Ring i18n and UA/EN clone work

layer_0_hardware_profile.description: M4 Max 36 GB constraints for Gemma 4

truths: 26B-A4B MLX 4bit: ~14–16 GB disk, ~10–12 GB working memory — comfortable on 36 GB
26B-A4B MLX 8bit: ~28–30 GB — quality ceiling on 36 GB with tight KV headroom
31B MLX 4bit: ~17–20 GB — fits; dense 30.7B active = slower than 26B-A4B MoE
31B MLX 8bit: ~34–38 GB — borderline on 36 GB; prefer 26B-A4B 8bit instead
E4B MLX 4bit: ~5–6 GB — secondary agent / classifier alongside primary model
Minimum free memory at load: ~14 GB for 26B-A4B 4bit per gemilab.net diagnostic
M4 Pro 24 GB 26B-A4B Q4: ~25–40 tok/s (sudoall.com field guide)
M4 Max 36 GB 26B-A4B: ~25–40 tok/s estimated at Q4 MLX
M5 Max 128 GB gemma4 Ollama: used as agent fallback in kyu.co May 2026 benchmarks
31B dense Q4: ~15–25 tok/s on M4 Max — slower than 26B-A4B MoE per active params
E4B edge: ~40–60 tok/s on 16 GB class hardware

layer_1_gemma4_model_family.description: Gemma 4 variants and selection for 36 GB

truths: Gemma 4 E2B: 2.3B dense edge; 128K context; text+image+audio; ~3.2 GB Q4
Gemma 4 E4B: 4.5B dense edge; 128K context; text+image+audio; ~5 GB Q4
Gemma 4 12B Unified: 12B dense multimodal; ~7–8 GB Q4
Gemma 4 26B-A4B: 26B MoE, 3.8B active, 128 experts; 256K context; text+image; ~16 GB Q4 / ~28 GB Q8
Gemma 4 31B: 30.7B dense; 256K context; text+image; ~17 GB Q4 / ~34 GB Q8
Apache 2.0 license across all variants
Hybrid thinking: reasoning mode available on larger models; configurable in LM Studio staff picks
E2B 4bit: 4 GB — trivial; edge deployment, audio classification
E4B 4bit: 5.5–6 GB — dual-model secondary role
26B-A4B 4bit: 16–18 GB — PRIMARY 36 GB recommendation
26B-A4B 8bit: 28–30 GB — quality ceiling on 36 GB
31B 4bit: 17–20 GB — fits; use only if dense quality required over MoE speed
31B 8bit: 34–38 GB — does NOT fit 36 GB comfortably
Unsloth UD-MLX-4bit recommended starting quant per unsloth.ai/docs/models/gemma-4
General agent on 36 GB → 26B-A4B MLX 4bit (speed + quality balance)
Multimodal vision agent → 26B-A4B mlx-vlm UD-4bit with image input
Maximum quality dense on 36 GB → 31B MLX 4bit (accept slower tok/s)
Dual-model setup → 26B-A4B 4bit primary + E4B 4bit validator (~21 GB total)
vs Qwen3.6-35B-A3B: Gemma 4 stronger multimodal (vision/audio edge); Qwen stronger pure coding benchmarks
vs GLM-4.7-Flash: Gemma broader general+vision; GLM stronger SWE-bench coding specialist
Ollama tag: gemma4:26b-a4b-it-q4_K_M (kyu.co benchmark reference)

layer_6_common_pitfalls.description: Gemma 4 failure modes on M4 Max

truth_lens.cause: LM Studio < 0.4.11 or stale mlx-engine backend without gemma4 arch
truth_lens.fix: Update to LM Studio 0.4.11+; verify mlx-engine 1.6.0+ in Runtime tab; use GGUF fallback meanwhile
Delete partial model folder; re-download; verify total size 14–16 GB for 26B-A4B 4bit

truth_lens.cause: 31B 8bit or 26B 8bit + macOS memory pressure on 36 GB
truth_lens.fix: Close apps; use 26B-A4B 4bit; or reduce n_ctx

truth_lens.cause: gemma4:31b-nvfp4 unexpectedly slow (~7 tok/s) per kyu.co May 2026 benchmarks
Community MLX upload missing tokenizer.json metadata
truth_lens.fix: Use mlx-community or unsloth official uploads; avoid incomplete community mirrors

anti_patterns: Loading Gemma 4 MLX on LM Studio < 0.4.11 — guaranteed 'not ready yet' error
Using 31B 8bit on 36 GB — OOM; use 26B-A4B 8bit instead
Choosing gemma4:31b-nvfp4 in Ollama for speed — community shows ~7 tok/s vs 26B-A4B ~25+ tok/s
Enabling hybrid thinking for JSON schema extraction — adds latency without benefit
Loading vision tasks on text-only GGUF without mlx-vlm — images silently ignored

meta.maintainer_notes: Fastest-growing Google open multimodal family. On 36 GB: 26B-A4B MLX 4bit default. Must verify LM Studio 0.4.11+ before MLX load.
